title: The signature, drawn large
summary: The letter's sign-off set at page scale — the 48px dash, “Rameez” at 128px, the role in the light accent — beside four plain facts, so the person behind the firm is real and senior without a portrait or an invented team.
story: Answers the arrival question from the letter's signature link: who is this? A person, named, with a role, a way to write to him and an honest count of the firm (one architect; the next seat opens when the work needs it). The way back to the letter sits under the name; the memo itself is not reprinted.
copy: (FC) Role “Founder · Lead Narrative Architect” [K] — also in the header facts; drafted alternative there: “Led by · Rameez”, so the role is said once, here
[N] (FC) On an engagement · Runs the audit’s working sessions, writes the readout, and leads the architecture and the install.
[N] (FC) The firm today · One architect. The next seat, a Systems Engineer, opens when the work needs it. → Careers
Background line: deliberately absent; renders only if the founder supplies one (D11 / §7 Q1)
phone: ≤1023: the facts drop under the signature (cols 1–9), the name at 104px. ≤767: the name at 72px, the role at 22px, the facts full width with each key over its value (no side-by-side spec columns at 358px), set tight so the signature and the facts read as one block (letter link 28px under the role, facts 32px under it, 14px rows); links stay .ac-link. 857px at 390 with production's 72px padding (was 899).

reference.site: Approved Kelwin letter/S (the signature block: 48px dash, “Rameez”, “Founder, Kelwin”) · Mobbin, Studio Freight team page (names set as type, no portraits)
reference.borrowed: From the letter: the sign-off's own order (dash, name, role). From Studio Freight: people presented by name in large type alone, no headshots.
reference.kelwin: One person, not a roster: the name in the wide display cut at 128px with the role in the light accent, and the facts as the kit's mono-key spec list. Nothing invented: the firm today is said as one architect, with the next seat linked to Careers.

motion: entrance (reveal only, a still beat): the label fades, the name rises inside its mask, the role rises, the four facts fade in top to bottom, the letter link fades in, and the signature dash draws last above the name, as the letter's dash does.
ambient: none. interaction: hover states on the three links.
on the live site: plays once when the section scrolls into view. Reduced motion: final state at once.
notes: The story map lists the dash after the role; it is placed ABOVE the name here, exactly as the letter's signature draws it, so the echo reads at first glance. The email is an .ac-link (caps), as the kit's QC door sets it.
